_note: Example consent gate. Copy this file to consent.json and edit it. An agent runs only when enabled is true, overseerAck is true and the grant has not expired. Optional `limits` are enforced by acp/consent.mjs: maxPermission (deny < allow-reads < allow-all), writeTrees (where allow-all may run; the system temp dir is always allowed for bench copies), maxBudgetUsd (clamps the requested budget), maxDailyUsd (reported cost today for that agent). Every grant below is disabled on purpose: a fresh clone runs nothing until its owner decides otherwise.

claude.scope: Example: prompt-only runs. Set enabled and overseerAck to grant more.

opencode.scope: Example: the default worker. Add the trees it may write to writeTrees.

codex.scope: Example: escalation and hard coding work. Codex harness settings stay native.

starnet.scope: Optional ACP station. Disabled: registered but not granted.
